description:
An adult jellyfish. A cyst-like stage. A colony of polyps.

Turritopsis dohrnii can follow this extraordinary developmental route, and the colony can bud new jellyfish. It can still die; reversal does not guarantee survival.

Original biological illustration; development is time-compressed, not microscopy. Synthetic narration; original sound.

Sources:
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6893190/
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9459311/
https://www.nhm.ac.uk/discover/immortal-jellyfish-secret-to-cheating-death.html

#MarineLife #CellBiology #Magnivis
